desc:
Everveil is a calm fantasy RPG about exploring a big world at your own pace. Roll for one of 14 elements and learn its spells, collect armour and swords, forge and enchant your gear, take on quests and bounties, go fishing, find hidden secrets and ride your horse across the land. When you feel ready, face the great bosses of Everveil, like the White Death, Grimhide and Cerberus. Trade with friends or use the auction house, and be the first player to own a legendary item to earn a title no one else has.

Controls:
WASD - Move
Space - Jump
Left Click - Attack
1 / 2 / 3 - Sword, staff, tool
Z X C V - Sword moves or spells
Q - Dash
F - Block
Shift (hold) - Sprint
Ctrl - Shift lock
E - Interact
R - Mount
M - Inventory
H - Drink potion
J - Journal
K - Codex
G - Map
N - Talents
Y - Finish
T - Carry
`  - Emote
